items.content_html: Pastebin‑Lite is a lightweight Next.js App Router app combining API and UI in one codebase. It uses Upstash Redis for serverless storage, enforcing TTL and view limits to control paste access without background jobs. Designed for scalability and deterministic testing, it ensures secure, predictable snippet sharing.
